articles.title: Scientists Name a Brand-New Penguin Species — First Discovery in Over 100 Years
articles.summary: For the first time in more than a century, researchers have identified a previously unknown species of penguin. Scientists used genetic testing to study gentoo penguins living on the remote Kerguelen Islands in the southern ocean and found that these birds are actually a separate species — meaning gentoo penguins are now known to include four distinct species rather than one. The discovery is exciting for wildlife science, but it also comes with a warning: rising ocean temperatures caused by climate change could put these newly identified penguins in danger. Warmer seas mean less food and fewer safe places to live, threatening the survival of this rare species before most people even knew it existed.

lv1: What type of animal did scientists discover a new species of? (科學家發現了哪一種動物的新物種？)
Where do these newly discovered penguins live? (這種新發現的企鵝住在哪裡？)
lv2: How did scientists figure out that these penguins were a different species from other gentoo penguins? (科學家如何判斷這些企鵝與其他白眉企鵝屬於不同物種？)
Why might warming oceans be a serious problem for this newly discovered penguin species? (海洋變暖為什麼對這種新發現的企鵝物種構成嚴重威脅？)
lv3: Should governments around the world immediately place this new penguin species on the endangered list, even though scientists have only just discovered it? What reasons support or challenge this idea? (各國政府是否應立即將這種新發現的企鵝列為瀕危物種，即使科學家剛剛才發現它？請列出支持或反對的理由。)

Some people argue that spending money on protecting rare animal species in remote areas is wasteful when humans face bigger problems. Do you agree or disagree, and why? (有人認為，在人類面臨更大問題的情況下，花錢保護偏遠地區的珍稀動物是浪費資源。你同意嗎？為什麼？)

articles.title: New 'Green' Concrete Is Stronger and Soaks Up Carbon Dioxide from the Air
articles.summary: A team of scientists has developed a new type of concrete that does two helpful things at once: it is stronger than regular concrete, and it can absorb carbon dioxide (CO₂) — one of the main gases causing climate change. The researchers tested different mixtures and found that the best recipe combines a natural mineral called zeolite with bamboo biochar, a charcoal-like material made from bamboo. This special blend made the concrete about 7.5% stronger in compression and 15% stronger under stretching forces. Buildings and roads use enormous amounts of concrete worldwide, so if this greener version becomes widely used, it could help reduce the amount of CO₂ in the atmosphere and slow down global warming.

lv1: What two special things can this new type of concrete do? (這種新型混凝土有哪兩個特別的功能？)
What materials were mixed together to make the best concrete formula? (哪些材料混合在一起製造出最好的混凝土配方？)
lv2: Why is it important for construction materials like concrete to be able to absorb carbon dioxide? (為什麼像混凝土這樣的建築材料能夠吸收二氧化碳很重要？)
How might this new concrete help fight climate change if it is used in cities around the world? (如果這種新型混凝土在全球城市中廣泛使用，它如何有助於應對氣候變化？)
lv3: Even if this green concrete is more expensive to produce, should governments require builders to use it by law? Consider arguments from the perspectives of the environment, the economy, and fairness. (即使這種環保混凝土的生產成本較高，政府是否應立法要求建築商使用？請從環境、經濟和公平性三個角度分析。)

Scientists are finding ways to make building materials absorb CO₂. Do you think technology alone can solve climate change, or do we also need people to change their everyday habits? Explain your view. (科學家正在研發能吸收二氧化碳的建築材料。你認為單靠科技能否解決氣候變化問題，還是我們也需要改變日常習慣？請說明你的看法。)

articles.title: 港府研究管理流浪狗新措施　謝展寰：盡量避免人道處理
articles.summary: 香港政府正就管理流浪狗的政策進行檢討。環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，當局希望盡量避免以「人道處理」即人道毀滅的方式處置流浪狗。與此同時，有動物保護團體指出，北部都會區的收地工程可能令更多流浪狗失去棲身之所，令問題更趨嚴峻。如何在城市發展與動物福利之間取得平衡，成為社會關注焦點。政府表示將繼續與各持份者溝通，研究更人道及有效的解決方案。

lv1: 香港政府正在研究如何管理哪種動物？
局長謝展寰希望盡量避免用什麼方式處理流浪狗？
lv2: 為什麼北部都會區的收地工程可能令流浪狗問題變得更嚴重？
除了人道處理之外，你認為還有哪些方法可以幫助管理流浪狗？
lv3: 在城市發展與動物福利之間，政府應如何取得平衡？請從不同持份者（如居民、動物保護團體、發展商）的角度分析。
有人認為人道處理流浪動物是無可避免的城市管理手段，亦有人認為這做法不人道。你認為社會應如何制定相關政策？

articles.title: 上海舉行人形機械人格鬥大賽　靈活彈起令觀眾嘆為觀止
articles.summary: 上海近日舉辦了一場別開生面的人形機械人格鬥比賽，多台真人大小的機械人在八角籠擂台上互相對戰，場面猶如科幻電影。參賽機械人不單能施展迴旋飛踢，更能在倒地後瞬間彈起重新站立，展現出驚人的靈活性與結構穩定性。比賽全程均由機械人自主進行，沒有人手操控。今次賽事標誌著人工智能與機械人技術的重大進步，引發各界對機械人在未來社會中扮演角色的廣泛討論。

lv1: 今次在上海舉行的比賽，參賽者是什麼？
機械人在倒地後能做到什麼令人驚訝的動作？
lv2: 機械人能在格鬥中自主作出反應，這說明了人工智能技術達到了什麼水平？
為什麼人形機械人格鬥比賽會引起社會各界廣泛討論？
lv3: 如果人形機械人技術持續進步，未來機械人有可能取代人類從事哪些工作？這對社會有什麼好處和壞處？
有人擔心高度靈活的人形機械人若被用於軍事或危險用途，將帶來安全風險。你認為社會應如何規管機械人技術的發展？
